Atom.description: One iotbx.pdb.hierarchy atom label. xyz/occ/b live in the parent Hierarchy npz at the same index.

i.description: Row index into packed xyz; same i_seq as scatterers and restraints

Atom.title: Atom

CartesianSites.description: cctbx xrs.sites_cart() / hierarchy atoms xyz in Å. npz array xyz float64[N,3].

crystal.description: Optional; needed to convert to fractional

CartesianSites.title: CartesianSites

CctbxObject.description: Base for canonical phenix/cctbx types. Metadata in JSON; array buffers in a packed npz referenced by ObjectRef.key.
CctbxObject.title: CctbxObject

ComplexMap.description: Complex grid (e.g. P1 Fourier map before taking the real part). Packed data is complex128 with shape n_real.

dtype.description: Canonical store dtype; v1 is complex128

ComplexMap.title: ComplexMap

d_min.description: Resolution (Å) used to choose the grid, when known

CrystalSymmetry.description: Canonical form of cctbx.crystal.symmetry. JSON only; no binary blob. v1 stores Hall + IT number and does not normalize non-standard settings or reindexing. Converters must fail loudly if crystal.symmetry cannot be reconstructed.

space_group_hall.description: Hall symbol as understood by cctbx.sgtbx

space_group_number.description: International Tables space-group number when known

symops.description: Optional full list of symmetry operators (centering included), x' = r @ x + t in fractional coordinates. Exported by the client from sgtbx so a worker without cctbx can expand to P1.

unit_cell.description: a, b, c (Å), alpha, beta, gamma (degrees)

CrystalSymmetry.title: CrystalSymmetry

EmMap.description: Canonical iotbx.map_manager map (cryo-EM or wrapping MX). Packed data same as RealMap. Extra metadata is EM/MRC specific origin, voxel size, wrapping, and experiment_type.

pixel_sizes.description: Voxel size (Å) along a, b, c

EmMap.title: EmMap

FractionalSites.description: cctbx xrs.sites_frac(). npz array xyz float64[N,3].
FractionalSites.title: FractionalSites

GeometryRestraints.description: Canonical cctbx.geometry_restraints.manager proxy tables. i_seq values index the corresponding Hierarchy / XrayStructure.

bond_asu_rt_mx.description: sgtbx.rt_mx.as_xyz() for each ASU bond, same order as bond_asu_i_seqs

n_sites.description: Atom/scatterer count in the i_seq space

GeometryRestraints.title: GeometryRestraints

HendricksonLattman.description: Canonical HL coefficients (cctbx miller array of hendrickson_lattman). npz arrays A,B,C,D float64[N] plus hkl.
HendricksonLattman.title: HendricksonLattman

Hierarchy.description: Canonical iotbx.pdb.hierarchy.root. Cartesian frame. npz: xyz, occupancy, b_iso; optional u_cart [N,6] U in Å² and uij_defined uint8 mask (PDB ANISOU).

has_uij.description: True if u_cart is present in the npz

Hierarchy.title: Hierarchy

inputs.description: Map of input name to ObjectRef

outputs.description: Map of output name to ObjectRef (filled by worker)

schema_version.description: Must match this schema file version (1)

MapCoefficients.description: Complex miller array used as FFT map coefficients (cctbx miller array of Fcalc / 2mFo-DFc coefficients). npz: hkl int32[N,3], data complex128[N].
MapCoefficients.title: MapCoefficients

MillerArray.description: Canonical form of cctbx.miller.array. JSON metadata; buffers in one npz (hkl, data, optional sigmas).

anomalous_layout.description: ASU vs both hemispheres; never inferred

data_dtype.description: Canonical store dtype for data; v1 is float64 or complex128

index_dtype.description: Canonical store dtype for hkl; v1 is int32

label.description: MTZ / miller array id (e.g. FOBS, IMEAN)

MillerArray.title: MillerArray

ModelGeometry.description: Correspondence header asserting that hierarchy, xray scatterers, and restraints share one i_seq space of size n_sites. Payloads remain separate ObjectRefs (Hierarchy, XrayStructure, GeometryRestraints) with matching n_atoms / n_scatterers / n_sites.

i_seq_identity.description: True when Hierarchy.atoms[i].i == XrayStructure.scatterers[i].i == i for all i in 0..n_sites-1, and every restraint i_seq is in that range.

ModelGeometry.title: ModelGeometry

MtzColumnType.description: CCP4 MTZ column type character (iotbx.mtz column.type()). H/K/L are indices and are not stored as ReflectionColumn rows.
MtzColumnType.title: MtzColumnType

ObjectRef.description: Pointer at bytes in Redis plus enough metadata to decode them. For kind=cctbx, meta is the inlined cctbx class (CrystalSymmetry, MillerArray, or RealMap). Binary buffers for miller/map are a packed npz at key.

cctbx_type.description: Cctbx class name when kind=cctbx (MillerArray, RealMap, CrystalSymmetry)

key.description: Redis key for bytes; omitted for JSON-only CrystalSymmetry

meta.description: Kind-specific JSON (ArrayMeta, BlobMeta, or a CctbxObject)

ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef

anyOf.description: Generic kind (array, json, blob) or cctbx class name
Generic kind (array, json, blob) or cctbx class name

runtime.description: Which worker stream consumes this op (torch vs cctbx)

RealMap.description: Canonical real-space map (maptbx / iotbx.ccp4_map / flex.double 3-D). Packed data.shape must equal n_real (nx, ny, nz).

dtype.description: Canonical store dtype; v1 is float64

RealMap.title: RealMap

ReflectionColumn.description: One data column in a ReflectionFile (not H/K/L).

mtz_type_raw.description: Original iotbx.mtz column.type() if not in the enum

npz_name.description: Array name inside the packed npz (usually the label)

ReflectionColumn.title: ReflectionColumn

ReflectionColumn__identifier_optional.description: One data column in a ReflectionFile (not H/K/L).

mtz_type_raw.description: Original iotbx.mtz column.type() if not in the enum

npz_name.description: Array name inside the packed npz (usually the label)

ReflectionColumn__identifier_optional.title: ReflectionColumn

ReflectionFile.description: Canonical iotbx.mtz.object / miller array set sharing one hkl. JSON metadata; one npz with hkl plus named columns. Does not preserve MTZ batches, original-index columns, or history verbatim beyond the history strings slot.
ReflectionFile.title: ReflectionFile

Scatterer.description: One cctbx.xray.scatterer label. Numeric site/occ/u live in the parent XrayStructure npz at the same index.

anisotropic.description: If true, npz u_star[i] is live (cctbx u_star, fractional)

i.description: Row index into packed sites; same i_seq as Hierarchy atoms and restraints

scattering_type.description: cctbx scattering type (C, N, S, AU, water, …)

use_u_iso.description: cctbx flags.use_u_iso(); may be true together with anisotropic

Scatterer.title: Scatterer

ScatteringTable.description: Gaussian form-factor coefficients per scattering type (cctbx scattering_type_registry, e.g. wk1995 / it1992 / n_gaussian). npz: gauss_a [T,K], gauss_b [T,K], gauss_c [T]; unused terms zero.

labels.description: Scattering type label per row (C, N, O, S, Se, water, ...)

n_terms.description: K, number of Gaussian terms per row

ScatteringTable.title: ScatteringTable

SfCurvatures.description: Per-atom Gauss-Newton curvature blocks diag/blocks of J^T H_F J, index-aligned with the XrayStructure. npz: site_frac [N,3,3], occupancy [N], u_iso [N], u_star [N,6,6], fp [N], fdp [N]. Inactive ADP entries are zero.
SfCurvatures.title: SfCurvatures

SfEngineParams.description: Gridding / accuracy controls for the FFT structure-factor engine. JSON only. Mirrors cctbx structure_factors.from_scatterers FFT settings (grid_resolution_factor, quality_factor, wing_cutoff).

n_real.description: Explicit FFT gridding (nx, ny, nz); derived from d_min if absent

u_extra.description: Override the extra isotropic U added before sampling

wing_cutoff.description: Relative density at the sampling cutoff radius (default 1e-4)

SfEngineParams.title: SfEngineParams

SfGradients.description: d(target)/d(scatterer parameters), index-aligned with the XrayStructure the gradients were computed for. All arrays are present; entries for inactive parameters (u_iso of an anisotropic scatterer, u_star of an isotropic one) are zero. npz: d_site_frac [N,3], d_occupancy [N], d_u_iso [N], d_u_star [N,6], d_fp [N], d_fdp [N].

target.description: Target value when the gradients came from a target op

SfGradients.title: SfGradients

type.description: Generic kind (array, json, blob) or cctbx class name
Generic kind (array, json, blob) or cctbx class name

SymOp.description: One symmetry operator in fractional coordinates. r is row-major 3x3 (9 values), t is 3 values. Rational parts are stored as floats.
SymOp.title: SymOp

TargetResult.description: Evaluation of a reciprocal-space target on a reflection list. npz: per_reflection [N], d_target_d_f_calc complex128[N] (cctbx convention dQ/dA + i dQ/dB, zero on free reflections), optional curv_radial [N] (d2g/d|F|2) and curv_tangential [N] ((dg/d|F|)/|F|) for amplitude-only targets.

scale_factor.description: Scale used or fitted by the target

value_test.description: Target on the test set when r_free flags were given

TargetResult.title: TargetResult

XrayStructure.description: Canonical cctbx.xray.structure. npz: sites_frac [N,3], occupancy [N], u_iso [N], u_star [N,6] (U* fractional, adptbx.u_cart_as_u_star). Mixed iso/aniso allowed.
XrayStructure.title: XrayStructure

description: Pointer at bytes in Redis plus enough metadata to decode them. For kind=cctbx, meta is the inlined cctbx class (CrystalSymmetry, MillerArray, or RealMap). Binary buffers for miller/map are a packed npz at key.

cctbx_type.description: Cctbx class name when kind=cctbx (MillerArray, RealMap, CrystalSymmetry)

key.description: Redis key for bytes; omitted for JSON-only CrystalSymmetry

meta.description: Kind-specific JSON (ArrayMeta, BlobMeta, or a CctbxObject)

title: phridge
